# arianet_images (Data Source)

Images a server can be created from (`GET /cloud/v1/images`): platform system/app images and the account's snapshots and backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_images" "system" {
  type       = "system"
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
}

output "image_slugs" {
  value = [for i in data.arianet_images.system.images : i.image]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `datacenter` (String) Only images available in this datacenter (location).
- `label_selector` (String) Only images matching this label selector.
- `type` (String) Only `system`, `app`, `snapshot` or `backup` images.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup.
- `images` (Attributes List) The images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of a snapshot/backup.
- `datacenters` (List of String) Datacenters that have the image.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the image is deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Image ID (the slug for system/app images, a number for snapshots and backups).
- `image` (String) What `arianet_server.image` takes.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels (snapshots and backups).
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Smallest root disk the image fits on.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `project_id` (Number) Project of a snapshot/backup (0 for platform images).
- `status` (String) Status.
- `type` (String) `system`, `app`, `snapshot` or `backup`.
